evidence.note: Disabled .s cleanup to keep generated assembly, compiled failing test 00020 in isolation, read the .s file, added debug prints in type_checker to trace variable resolution, fixed, then re-ran the single executable to confirm before the full suite — the core tight verification loop.

Compiled 00200.c with system GCC to obtain the known-correct expected output and debug prints, then diffed against its own compiler's behavior to localize a cast/type-promotion miscompile — direct comparison against a reference implementation (level-8 hallmark).

Wrote and repeatedly rewrote a minimal repro (/app/test_shift.c) varying sub-expressions (PTYPE macro, unsigned short, inline constants) to isolate exactly which construct diverged — minimal-reproduction discipline.

Segfault in 00207: read generated .s multiple times, attempted gdb/strace (unavailable), built fflush-instrumented repro to bisect which function crashed, then pinpointed pointer-truncation codegen bug — root-cause isolation distinguishing codegen from parser/sema.

After each fix rebuilt and re-ran the full 780-test suite to check pass count and catch regressions, tracking c_testsuite 100% then 611/780; regression detection was via full-suite reruns rather than an engineered subset/guard harness, keeping it below the level-10 anchor.

reasoning: The agent sustained a tight, self-correcting verification loop across the whole build: per-feature single-test isolation, assembly inspection, minimal repro programs, and explicit diffing against GCC known-correct output to determine which pass was miscompiling before editing — matching the level-8 anchor closely. It does not reach 10 because it built no categorized/scriptable subset runner or dedicated regression guards, relying on full-suite reruns for regression detection, so it sits solidly at 8.
